after.summary: The Government of Canada and the Bank of Canada jointly review and renew the Bank’s monetary policy framework every five years. We also agree that the best way monetary policy can do this is by keeping inflation low, stable, and predictable, thereby protecting Canadians from large increases in the cost of living. A credible and well understood monetary policy framework that focuses on price stability helps the economy grow, supports investment and job creation, and fosters confidence in Canada’s economy.

items.title: Building a stronger Canada through a well-managed, predictable immigration system
items.content_text: An immigration system that is well-managed, efficient and focused on our economic needs is key to building Canada strong. Every year, Canada tables an immigration levels plan outlining the targets for temporary and permanent resident admissions for the next three years. Last year and through Budget 2025, we committed to taking back control over the immigration system and putting Canada on a trajectory to bring immigration back to sustainable levels.
